name: Phenazocine
summary: Phenazocine (brand names Prinadol, Narphen) is an opioid analgesic drug, which is related to pentazocine and has a similar profile of effects.

pharmacology.text: Effects of phenazocine include analgesia and euphoria, also may include dysphoria and hallucinations at high doses, most likely due to action at κ-opioid and σ receptors. Phenazocine appears to be a much stronger analgesic with fewer side effects than pentazocine, probably due to a more favorable μ/κ binding ratio.
pharmacology.kind: κ-Opioid receptor agonist; μ-Opioid receptor agonist–antagonist; Opioid analgesic; Hallucinogen

summaryZh: 非那佐辛是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C22H27NO，化學結構上與噴他佐辛類似，能作為類阿片鎮痛藥。

uses.en: It was used as a painkiller, under names such as Narphen, and is no longer marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾以 Narphen 等商品名作為止痛藥使用，現已不再販售。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以 Narphen 等商品名作为止痛药使用，现已不再贩售。

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Drugs of this mixed type can also cause unpleasant mood changes and hallucinations.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。這類混合型藥物也可能造成不愉快的情緒變化與幻覺。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。这类混合型药物也可能造成不愉快的情绪变化与幻觉。

fact.en: It is a benzomorphan, from the same family as pentazocine. For a time it was given for the pain of gallstones and bile duct disease.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯并嗎啡喃類，與噴他佐辛同一家族。它曾有一段時間用於膽結石與膽道疾病的疼痛。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯并吗啡喃类，与喷他佐辛同一家族。它曾有一段时间用于胆结石与胆道疾病的疼痛。
